mainEntity.name: How long does window opening framing usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline depends on whether you are simply framing a planned opening or modifying an existing wall. A straightforward framing job can move quickly, but adding a header, correcting damage, or working around utilities usually adds time. In practice, permitting and inspection timing can matter as much as the carpentry itself.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple framing can be quick, but structural changes, repairs, and permits can add time. The schedule is usually driven by wall condition, header work, and inspection timing.
